simple.meaning: גַב (gab) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the back (as rounded); by analogy, the top or rim , a boss , a vault , arch of eye , bulwarks , etc.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Leviticus 14:9. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גַב (H1354) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: the back (as rounded); by analogy, the top or rim , a boss , a vault , arch of eye , bulwarks , etc.
definitions.usage: back, body, boss, eminent (higher) place, (eye) brows, nave, ring.
definitions.full: H1354. gab גַּב back , etc., see below גבב [ גָּב ], גָּבִים see גוב . גַּב noun masculine :? compare Ezek 43:13 ( feminine 1:18 ) anything convex, curved, gibbous, e.g. back , chiefly late; — absolute גָּ֑ב 16:24 ; construct גַּב 43:13 (read ᵐ5 גֹּבַהּ Ew Sm Co); suffix גַּבִּי Psa 129:3 , גַּבֵךְ Ezek 16:31 , 39 ; plural construct גַּבֹּת Lev 14:9 , גַּבֵּי Job 13:12 ; 15:26 ; suffix גַּבֵּיהֶם 1Kin 7:33 , גַּבֵּהֶם Ezek 10:12 , גַּבֵּיהֶן 1:18 , גַֹּבֹּתָם 1:18 ; — 1 back , of man (figurative of Israel) Psa 129:3 ; apparently of cherubim Ezek 10:12 , but Hi Sm emend v. so that ׳גּ refers to wheels, rim see 6 below 2 mound , for illicit worship Ezek 16:24 , 31 , 39 (all || רמה ); ᵑ9 ᵐ5 lupanar, brothel , after analogy of fornix , but this without sufficient proof, & needless. 3 boss , or convex projection, of shield Job 15:26 (figurative) he runneth against him... with the stout bosses of his shields (i.e. wicked against ׳י ); so in Arabic in similar phrase; compare also Arabic , shield ; also French bouclier from boucle . 4 bulwarks, breastworks , figurative for arguments גַּבֵּיכֶם לְגַבֵּיחֹֿמֶר Job 13:12 breastworks of clay are your breastworks . 5 brow , only עֵינָיו גַּבֹּת Lev 14:9 his eyebrows . 6 rim of wheel, felloe 1Kin 7:33 ; Ezek 1:18 (twice in verse); so perhaps 10:12 see 1 above — 43:13 ; elevation , i.e. basement of altar, Da after MT., but see גֹּבַהּ , compare above
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to hollow or curve; (compare 1460 and 1479 )
